summary: Lot B MARCEL frontend E2E validated via Playwright with test.audit@altair.fr. All 6 features work: MFA UI (inspect-only, left DISABLED), dark mode, i18n FR/EN nav, onboarding tour (4 steps + localStorage persistence), Présentation COMEX, favoris projets (persist across reload). Regression on /portfolio /pilotage /governance /applications passes (0 error elements, page content present). Minor testid gaps documented below.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid mfa-cancel-btn on MFA setup panel — user cannot cancel setup with a testid-driven click; only escape is navigating away. Also missing data-testid mfa-secret on the manual secret text ("Clé manuelle : …") — currently only mfa-qr is tagged.
Slide navigation arrows (chevron left/right) have no data-testid (e.g. presentation-next-btn / presentation-prev-btn / presentation-close-btn). Makes automated navigation between slides fragile.

Actual per-project favorite testid is `tile-favorite-{projectId}`; the spec/request mentioned `project-favorite-*`. This is a naming inconsistency between spec and implementation (not a bug, but confusing).

detailed_results.onboarding: PASS - 4 steps (Suivant×3 + 'C'est parti !'), does NOT reappear after page reload (localStorage marcel_onboarded_<user_id>).
detailed_results.dark_mode: PASS - theme-toggle-btn adds/removes 'dark' class on <html>; persists across /portfolio and /pilotage; screenshots show readable text on dark bg; toggle-back restores light.
detailed_results.i18n: PASS - lang-toggle-btn switches document.documentElement.lang between fr/en; 10 nav items translated (Home↔Accueil, Dashboard↔Tableau de bord, Programs↔Programmes, Portfolio↔Portefeuille, Steering↔Pilotage, Objectives↔Objectifs, Governance↔Gouvernance, Approvals↔Validations). data-testid remain canonical French (nav-accueil, nav-tableau-de-bord…).
detailed_results.presentation: PASS - dashboard-presentation-btn present on /dashboard (NOT on /home which is 'Accueil'). Click opens presentation overlay (URL stays /dashboard but body renders presentation content 8k chars). Direct /presentation route also loads (heading 'Portefeuille projets DSI', 5 slide pagination dots visible, chevron nav present but untagged).
detailed_results.favorites: PASS - tile-favorite-{uuid} toggles class from bg-white/border-[#e0dcf0] (empty) to bg-amber-400 border-amber-400 text-white (active); SVG fill changes to 'currentColor'. State persists after full page reload. Cleanup toggle restores original empty state (test.audit@altair.fr left with no favorites).
detailed_results.mfa: PASS - Section shows 'DÉSACTIVÉE' status. mfa-enable-btn triggers setup: QR displayed with mfa-qr testid, manual secret 'H2UM7ER7YLQWEUTD6GOET4PCKCSY7CWS' shown (no testid). Setup abandoned by navigation (no cancel button). Post-navigation status still DÉSACTIVÉE — MFA NOT activated, account left clean as required.
detailed_results.regression: PASS - /portfolio (2729 chars), /pilotage (1605), /governance (8943), /applications (1267); 0 elements matching .error selector on any of them.

action_items: Add data-testid="mfa-cancel-btn" to the MFA setup cancel/back action (currently missing).
Add data-testid="mfa-secret" to the manual secret span (currently only mfa-qr is tagged).
Add data-testid="presentation-next-btn" / presentation-prev-btn / presentation-close-btn to the slide navigation controls.
Reconcile spec wording ("project-favorite") with actual implementation ("tile-favorite-{id}") — either rename or update the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: MFA cancel path relies on browser navigation because setup panel exposes no explicit cancel control with a testid — consider adding an explicit "Annuler" button so users don't have to leave /account to abandon setup.

Presentation route uses same URL as /dashboard when triggered via button (overlay), yet direct /presentation is also supported — behaviour is dual and could confuse deep-linking; consider aligning to a single canonical route.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (6/6 features work), 3 minor testid gaps

test_credentials: test.audit@altair.fr / MonCompte2026! (used for all destructive-capable tests; MFA left DISABLED at end).
seed_data_creation: None. One favorite was toggled on then off on portfolio tile b38a623c-… so account state is unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend Lot B fully passes E2E. If retesting MFA: use only test.audit@altair.fr, and remember there is NO mfa-cancel-btn — you must navigate away to abandon setup without entering a code. Favorites live under selector [data-testid^='tile-favorite-'] not project-favorite-*. Presentation button lives on /dashboard, not /home. Onboarding key is marcel_onboarded_<user_id> in localStorage.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bug found. The three items reported are missing data-testid attributes (accessibility of automated tests), not functional defects.
